title: Modern HR Dashboard
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

asset_issues.detail: Exact external stylesheet and original Regular WOFF2 recovered. Supplied stylesheet defines Regular only; its original font is locally mapped to the required Medium CSS family as documented in README.md.

notes: Ready for management-session review; not deployed.
All six supplied Pexels images are local and loaded successfully.
Real React DOM, SVG background and timer, Recharts chart; no screenshot used as page content.
Task and timer state are session-local; navigation selects tabs without adding unspecified pages.
Small-screen calendar event widths adapted for readability.
Exact requested dependency versions preserved; npm-audit.json records 1 moderate and 2 high build-tool findings. Vite emits a non-blocking bundle-size warning.
README.md documents commands, verification, asset sources, font mapping, and limitations.
